title: Initial geographic intelligence scopes
description: A deliberately limited hierarchy for global, MENA, GCC and current-source country context. Event locationName remains descriptive; this taxonomy does not provide full GIS modeling.
governanceNotes: parentCode expresses the primary analytical hierarchy and does not claim exclusive geographic, political or economic membership.
Overlapping memberships may later be modeled through a GeographicMembership relationship.
The current country list remains intentionally limited; this amendment does not expand it.

terms.label: Global
terms.definition: Worldwide scope not limited to a single region or country.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use when information is explicitly global or materially multi-regional; do not use merely because no location has been identified.

terms.label: Middle East and North Africa
terms.definition: The broad Middle East and North Africa regional context used for cross-country intelligence.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for explicitly MENA-wide or multi-country context; country-specific events should use their country scope as well or instead.

terms.label: Western Asia
terms.definition: The United Nations-style Western Asia subregional context used within the initial MENA hierarchy.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for explicitly Western Asian context; do not assume all MENA matters are Western Asian.

terms.label: Gulf Cooperation Council
terms.definition: The regional grouping of the six Gulf Cooperation Council member states.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for GCC-wide policy, market or regional context; do not use for every event in an individual Gulf country without GCC relevance.

terms.label: Qatar
terms.definition: The national geographic scope of the State of Qatar.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for events materially located in or concerning Qatar; publisher headquarters alone does not make content Qatari.

terms.label: Jordan
terms.definition: The national geographic scope of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for events materially located in or concerning Jordan; exclude general regional reporting without Jordan-specific relevance.

terms.label: European Union
terms.definition: The supranational geographic and policy scope of the European Union.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for EU-wide institutions, policy or markets; do not treat the European Union as a country or as equivalent to all of Europe.

terms.label: United States
terms.definition: The national geographic scope of the United States of America, required by current United States government sources.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for events materially concerning the United States; publisher origin alone does not determine article geography.

terms.label: United Kingdom
terms.definition: The national geographic scope of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, required by a current public-service source.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for events materially concerning the United Kingdom; BBC publication alone does not make content UK-specific.
aliases: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
